phone.title: Backups found on the phone
phone.body: {{count}} EasyAndroid backups were found on this phone. Copy them to the backup folder on this PC? You can restore them later from the Restore tab.
phone.rootWarning: Some of these backups contain app data that needs root. Allow root for the shell on the phone when it asks; without it those files may not be readable and you can get errors.

backup.title: Backup
backup.subtitle: Back up and restore apps on this PC

noDevice.title: No device connected
noDevice.step1: Enable Developer options: Settings > About phone > tap Build number seven times.
noDevice.step2: Turn on USB debugging in Developer options.
noDevice.step3: Connect a data-capable USB cable and choose File transfer if asked.
noDevice.step4: If Windows does not detect the phone, install the manufacturer's USB driver or try another port.

unauthorized.title: Authorization needed
unauthorized.step2: Accept the "Allow USB debugging?" prompt and tick Always allow.
unauthorized.step3: No prompt? Revoke USB debugging authorizations in Developer options and reconnect.

offline.title: Device is offline
offline.step1: Unplug the cable and connect it again.
offline.step2: Turn USB debugging off and on again.
offline.step3: Restart the adb server from the Terminal with: adb kill-server

adbMissing.title: ADB not found
adbMissing.step1: The bundled adb.exe is missing next to EasyADB.exe. Reinstall the application.

guide.wrongMode: This device is in {{state}} mode. Reboot it into Android to use this module.
guide.wireless: Prefer Wi-Fi? Use the Wireless module.

errors.adb_missing: ADB was not found next to the application.
errors.device_not_found: The device was not found. Is it still connected?
errors.device_unauthorized: The device has not authorized this computer.
errors.backup_invalid: This backup is invalid or from an unsupported version.
errors.integrity_failed: The backup is damaged or was modified.
errors.protected: This package is protected and cannot be disabled or removed.

install.title: Install
install.apkHint: Installs or updates a single APK file.
install.sideloadHint: The device must be in sideload mode (Recovery > Apply update from ADB).

backup.systemHint: System apps usually cannot be installed on another device.

archive.deleteConfirm: Delete the backup of {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
archive.batchConfirm: Restore {{count}} backups to the device? Apps are installed; where a backup has data and root is available, the app data is replaced.

restore.title: Restore {{name}}
restore.dataConfirm: Restoring app data replaces the current data of {{name}}. Continue?

report.noRoot: {{name}}: no root or root was denied. The app was installed, its data was not restored.
report.failed: {{name}}: the app was installed but its data could not be restored: {{detail}}
report.special: {{name}}: {{count}} special access settings could not be restored.

backup.dataSkipped: {{name}}: no root or root was denied. The app was backed up, its data was not.

root.available: Root available: app data can be copied.
root.missing: No root, or root was denied. App data cannot be copied, only the app itself. When the device asks, allow root for "Shell".

debloat.confirmUninstall: Remove {{count}} packages for the current user? They can be restored from this screen.
debloat.protected: Protected: this package cannot be disabled or removed because it can break the device.
debloat.noInfo: No information in the UAD-NG list.
debloat.skipped: {{count}} apps were skipped because the action does not apply to them.

code.intro: On the phone: Developer options > Wireless debugging > Pair device with pairing code.
code.paired: Paired. Now connect with the address shown under Wireless debugging.

qr.intro: On the phone: Wireless debugging > Pair device with QR code, then scan this code.
qr.done: Paired. The device appears in the list shortly.
qr.timeout: No phone found. Both devices must be on the same network.
qr.note: Uses mDNS discovery. Some networks block it; use the pairing code instead.

ip.intro: Connect to a paired device or one in TCP mode.

usb.intro: For Android 10 and older: connect over USB first, then switch the device to TCP mode.
usb.done: Connected to {{address}}. You can unplug the cable.

terminal.placeholder: adb or fastboot command, e.g. shell getprop ro.product.model
terminal.noDevice: No device selected: only global commands such as devices will work.
